rules: Follow every visible clue and constraint.
A move is only valid when it keeps the puzzle in a potentially solvable state.
The puzzle is complete only when the engine's exact win condition is satisfied.
tutorial: Read the objective and inspect fixed clues.
Make the most constrained move first; use Undo if needed.
Use Hint for a subtle nudge rather than a full solution.
tips: Use Reset to restart the same seed; New Puzzle generates a different seed.

sudoku.title: Classic Sudoku
sudoku.summary: Complete every row, column and 3×3 box with 1–9.
sudoku.objective: Complete every row, column and 3×3 box with 1–9.
sudoku.hint: Focus on rows, columns, or boxes with only one candidate left.

arrow-escape.title: Arrow Escape
arrow-escape.summary: Clear every arrow by sending it along a clear path off the board.
arrow-escape.objective: Clear every arrow by sending it along a clear path off the board.
arrow-escape.hint: Work from exposed edge arrows inward.

net.title: Pipe Routing
net.summary: Rotate every tile until all pipes form one connected network.
net.objective: Rotate every tile until all pipes form one connected network.
net.hint: Start with edge and corner tiles; their possible orientations are limited.

mines.title: Mines
mines.summary: Reveal every safe cell without opening a mine.
mines.objective: Reveal every safe cell without opening a mine.
mines.hint: Use numbered cells to count adjacent mines before guessing.

fifteen.title: Fifteen
fifteen.summary: Slide the numbered tiles into ascending order.
fifteen.objective: Slide the numbered tiles into ascending order.
fifteen.hint: Solve the top rows first and preserve finished sections.

keen.title: Keen
keen.summary: Fill the Latin square while satisfying every arithmetic cage.
keen.objective: Fill the Latin square while satisfying every arithmetic cage.
keen.hint: Use row/column exclusions before testing cage combinations.

hitori.title: Hitori
hitori.summary: Shade duplicates so visible numbers are unique and the white cells stay connected.
hitori.objective: Shade duplicates so visible numbers are unique and the white cells stay connected.
hitori.hint: Mark forced duplicate removals, then protect connectivity.

lightup.title: Light Up
lightup.summary: Illuminate every open square without bulbs seeing each other and satisfy wall clues.
lightup.objective: Illuminate every open square without bulbs seeing each other and satisfy wall clues.
lightup.hint: Numbered walls create strong local deductions.

loopy.title: Loopy
loopy.summary: Draw one non-branching closed loop satisfying every numbered clue.
loopy.objective: Draw one non-branching closed loop satisfying every numbered clue.
loopy.hint: Clues 0 and 3 often force several edges immediately.

bridges.title: Bridges
bridges.summary: Connect all islands into one network while matching each island number.
bridges.objective: Connect all islands into one network while matching each island number.
bridges.hint: Prioritize islands whose remaining degree can only be satisfied one way.

samegame.title: Same Game
samegame.summary: Remove connected colour groups and clear as much of the board as possible.
samegame.objective: Remove connected colour groups and clear as much of the board as possible.
samegame.hint: Prefer moves that merge larger groups before clearing them.

untangle.title: Untangle
untangle.summary: Reposition points until no connecting lines cross.
untangle.objective: Reposition points until no connecting lines cross.
untangle.hint: Resolve the densest crossing cluster first.

blackbox.title: Black Box
blackbox.summary: Locate hidden balls by interpreting edge-fired beam results.
blackbox.objective: Locate hidden balls by interpreting edge-fired beam results.
blackbox.hint: Combine hits, reflections, and paired exits before placing a ball.

dominosa.title: Dominosa
dominosa.summary: Partition adjacent numbers into the complete domino set exactly once.
dominosa.objective: Partition adjacent numbers into the complete domino set exactly once.
dominosa.hint: Track pairs that have only one possible placement.

galaxies.title: Galaxies
galaxies.summary: Partition the board into connected regions rotationally symmetric around their centres.
galaxies.objective: Partition the board into connected regions rotationally symmetric around their centres.
galaxies.hint: Mirror every claimed square through its galaxy centre.

guess.title: Guess
guess.summary: Deduce the hidden sequence from the feedback clues.
guess.objective: Deduce the hidden sequence from the feedback clues.
guess.hint: Use each clue to eliminate impossible positions and values.

inertia.title: Inertia
inertia.summary: Collect every gem while sliding until stopped, avoiding mines.
inertia.objective: Collect every gem while sliding until stopped, avoiding mines.
inertia.hint: Plan stopping squares before committing to a direction.

ink.title: Ink
ink.summary: Connect matching clues without crossing paths.
ink.objective: Connect matching clues without crossing paths.
ink.hint: Reserve narrow corridors for pairs with fewer routes.

magnets.title: Magnets
magnets.summary: Fill domino slots with magnetic poles while matching row and column counts.
magnets.objective: Fill domino slots with magnetic poles while matching row and column counts.
magnets.hint: Use completed count lines to eliminate remaining pole options.

maps.title: Map Colouring
maps.summary: Colour every region so edge-sharing neighbours have different colours.
maps.objective: Colour every region so edge-sharing neighbours have different colours.

net2.title: Network
net2.summary: Rotate pieces until the whole network is connected.
net2.objective: Rotate pieces until the whole network is connected.
net2.hint: Use boundary constraints to fix impossible outward connections.

netslide.title: Net Slide
netslide.summary: Cyclically slide rows and columns until all network tiles connect.
netslide.objective: Cyclically slide rows and columns until all network tiles connect.
netslide.hint: Look for near-complete rows/columns before shifting.

nullgame.title: Null Game
nullgame.summary: Flip cross-shaped groups until every cell is zero.
nullgame.objective: Flip cross-shaped groups until every cell is zero.
nullgame.hint: Work backward from isolated active cells.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.summary: Fill cells so every row and column matches its run-length clues.
pattern.objective: Fill cells so every row and column matches its run-length clues.
pattern.hint: Start with lines whose clues nearly fill the available space.

pearl.title: Pearl Loop
pearl.summary: Draw one loop satisfying every black and white pearl.
pearl.objective: Draw one loop satisfying every black and white pearl.
pearl.hint: Black pearls force turns; white pearls force straight passage.

pegs.title: Pegs
pegs.summary: Jump pegs over adjacent pegs into empty holes and finish with as few as possible.
pegs.objective: Jump pegs over adjacent pegs into empty holes and finish with as few as possible.

range.title: Range
range.summary: Shade cells so every clue equals the visible white range and white cells remain connected.
range.objective: Shade cells so every clue equals the visible white range and white cells remain connected.
range.hint: Large clues strongly constrain nearby black cells.

rect.title: Rectangles
rect.summary: Partition the board into rectangles containing exactly one clue whose value equals the rectangle area.
rect.objective: Partition the board into rectangles containing exactly one clue whose value equals the rectangle area.
rect.hint: List factor pairs for each clue before drawing rectangles.

sequencing.title: Sequencing
sequencing.summary: Arrange all numbered tiles into the correct progression.
sequencing.objective: Arrange all numbered tiles into the correct progression.
sequencing.hint: Place the most displaced values first to reduce later swaps.

signpost.title: Signpost
signpost.summary: Link all cells into one ordered chain following each arrow direction.
signpost.objective: Link all cells into one ordered chain following each arrow direction.
signpost.hint: Build chains outward from fixed endpoints and forced links.

singles.title: Singles
singles.summary: Complete the compact Latin square without repeats.
singles.objective: Complete the compact Latin square without repeats.
singles.hint: Use row and column exclusions to find forced values.

sixteen.title: Sixteen
sixteen.summary: Fill the 4×4 grid with 1–4 under the displayed constraints.
sixteen.objective: Fill the 4×4 grid with 1–4 under the displayed constraints.
sixteen.hint: Use the small grid to scan candidates systematically.

slant.title: Slant
slant.summary: Place diagonals so vertex clues match and no loop is formed.
slant.objective: Place diagonals so vertex clues match and no loop is formed.
slant.hint: A clue equal to its remaining empty incident cells forces them all.

solo.title: Solo
solo.hint: Scan rows and columns for missing values before guessing.

tents.title: Tents
tents.summary: Match one tent to each tree, satisfy row/column totals, and keep tents separated.
tents.objective: Match one tent to each tree, satisfy row/column totals, and keep tents separated.
tents.hint: Completed row and column totals immediately rule out cells.

towers.title: Towers
towers.summary: Fill 1–4 once per row and column while satisfying visibility clues.
towers.objective: Fill 1–4 once per row and column while satisfying visibility clues.
towers.hint: A clue of 1 forces the tallest tower at the near edge.

twiddle.title: Twiddle
twiddle.summary: Rotate groups of tiles until every number is in order.
twiddle.objective: Rotate groups of tiles until every number is in order.
twiddle.hint: Solve stable regions and avoid disturbing them.

undead.title: Undead
undead.summary: Restore the haunted network so every required connection is valid.
undead.objective: Restore the haunted network so every required connection is valid.
undead.hint: Start with cells that have the fewest legal connection patterns.

unequal.title: Unequal
unequal.summary: Fill the grid while obeying Latin-square and inequality constraints.
unequal.objective: Fill the grid while obeying Latin-square and inequality constraints.
unequal.hint: Use inequality chains to bound candidates.

unruly.title: Unruly
unruly.summary: Balance X and O with no forbidden repetitions.
unruly.objective: Balance X and O with no forbidden repetitions.
unruly.hint: Two equal symbols often force the neighbouring symbol to be opposite.

cube.title: Cube
cube.summary: Manipulate the cube-inspired board into its target state.
cube.objective: Manipulate the cube-inspired board into its target state.
cube.hint: Track one face or region at a time.

filling.title: Filling
filling.summary: Fill connected regions so each number equals its region size.
filling.objective: Fill connected regions so each number equals its region size.
filling.hint: Expand fixed clues only as far as their required size permits.

flip.title: Flip
flip.summary: Toggle cells or groups until the board matches the target pattern.
flip.objective: Toggle cells or groups until the board matches the target pattern.
flip.hint: Work from constrained edges where fewer moves affect each cell.
